title: Protection warrior: Shield Bashes a casting mob within 3 s of the cast start

rules.desc: The Protection warrior casts Shield Bash on the mob within 3 s of an interruptible cast start, at least 60 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 10 s, one counted answer per 12 s: Shield Bash has a 12 s cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:67-69 (shield bash at ACTION_INTERRUPT), :498-513 (protection cc: concussion blow, shield bash, shield bash on enemy healer); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/WarriorTriggers.h:133 (ShieldBashInterruptSpellTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the interrupt row outranks the rotation, but no baseline proves the hire reaches melee on a kiting caster within 3 s, and the 12 s cooldown caps answers at one per 12 s. Expected UNKNOWN at abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: the Protection warrior holds Defensive Stance (aura 71) for at least 85 percent of its in-combat samples, so the bashes come from a tank in stance
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:63-65 (defensive stance row, ACTION_HIGH + 2); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the stance row keeps the tank in Defensive Stance and Shield Bash needs no stance swap; without stance the interrupt numbers mean nothing. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
